request: Get size of a PLC tag

candidates.prompt: One square icon on pure white: A large blue tag above a thick orange ruler with three clear tick marks. Symbolize measuring tag size. Thick simple flat geometry, generous margins, no text, border or shadow.

signature.composition: A large blue tag above a thick orange ruler with three clear tick marks.

source.evidence: A blue tag sits over an orange ruler with three white marks.

29x29.evidence: Tag and ruler are separate and tick marks are visible.

30x18.evidence: The ruler ticks nearly disappear, leaving an unmarked orange bar.
30x18.cause: Essential tool or tag details are lost during reduction.
30x18.correction: Enlarge the measurement cue and tag, with fewer, thicker, separated features.

16x16.evidence: The tag and orange bar remain but tick marks disappear.
